claims.text: The FIFA World Cup 2026 opening ceremony will take place at Mexico City Stadium on Thursday, June 11, 2026 at 11:30 local time.
claims.evidence_sentence: Fans at the stadium will have an active role to play in the show and should plan to arrive early as each opening ceremony will begin 90 minutes before kick-off, starting in Mexico City on Thursday, 11 June at 11:30 local time.

claims.text: Alejandro Fernández, Belinda, Danny Ocean, J Balvin, Lila Downs, Los Ángeles Azules, Maná and Tyla are headliners performing at the opening ceremony.
claims.evidence_sentence: Those who will take the stage in a powerful performance to bring the sound of the Official FIFA World Cup 2026™ Album to life include Alejandro Fernández, Belinda, Danny Ocean, J Balvin, Lila Downs, Los Ángeles Azules, Maná and Tyla.

claims.text: The FIFA World Cup 2026 will feature 104 matches across 16 Host Cities.
